query:
-- Analisar reman orders existentes
SELECT 
  ro.id,
  ro.orderNumber,
  ro.notes,
  ro.status,
  ro.criado_em,
  COUNT(roi.id) as item_count,
  COUNT(rou.id) as unit_count
FROM reman_orders ro
LEFT JOIN reman_order_items roi ON ro.id = roi.order_id
LEFT JOIN reman_order_units rou ON roi.id = rou.order_item_id
GROUP BY ro.id
ORDER BY ro.id ASC
LIMIT 50;
